title: The students' register: one row per decision point, every number read from its file, on the Admin page and the command
request: The owner, on the little students (2026-10-17): 'I really love this idea; I want it in all small processes; this is one of DCLab's important goals; build it together and make it better; let's bring this idea into the platform.' 29.1: one place that shows every choice DCLab makes and where its student stands.
plan: Read, never compute: the ledger, the generated sets' manifests, the cards, the sealed verdicts, the routing document, the shadow measurement.
One status phrase per point: not decided, no homework, homework with no student, whisper (not examined, failed, ready after N labels, may act), flags, acts.
One read for the command and the page; every run of the command kept in the workspace.
An owner-only route and an Admin tab on the repository's page patterns.

decisions.decision: The register reads files and the ledger; it trains and examines nothing.
decisions.why: Each number already has one owner (a manifest, a card, a verdict); a second computation would drift from it.

decisions.decision: An exam belongs to the version that sat it, by name@version.
decisions.why: A retrained student never saw the sealed set; routing already refuses it, and the page must say the same.

decisions.decision: A failed or skipped shadow measurement is a warning on the page, never a count.
decisions.why: A count of labels still needed that was never measured would read as a fact.

decisions.decision: Every run of the command appends the register to <home>/students/register.jsonl.
decisions.why: The owner's capture rule: each student's standing over time is itself data (the report cards of 29.14 read it).

change: dclab_rnd/students.py (homework, students, verdicts, register, read, record, the CLI); dclab_rnd/agentic/pages/students.py (GET /api/students); guard.SPECIAL admin; pages MODULES; the Admin Students tab and its feature entry; make students; tests/test_students.py.

findings.defect: The workflow points' sealed count showed 0.
findings.scenario: solution.route sat its exam on 8 sealed decisions, kept in its result file; the manifest has only train and dev.
findings.cause: The sealed count was read from the manifest's splits only.
findings.fix: When the manifest gives none, the exam's own sealed count is shown, said as such.

findings.defect: The workflow points' homework and rule accuracy used the played rows, not the labelled ones.
findings.scenario: solution.route showed 414 decisions and a rule accuracy of 0.473; the file says 196 right of 220 labelled (0.891).
findings.cause: rows counted every played decision while rule_right counts the labelled.
findings.fix: The labelled count is the homework; the played rows and the people are kept beside it.

findings.defect: The command and the page computed the labels still needed differently.
findings.scenario: With 25 labelled disagreements the page said 'may act' and the command said 'after 20 labels', and kept that in the register's history.
findings.cause: Only the page took the shadow measurement.
findings.fix: One read for both; a measurement that failed or was off is a warning.

findings.defect: A retrained student would inherit its predecessor's exam.
findings.scenario: After 29.4 retrains a card, the register would still say 'pass' for a version that never saw the sealed set.
findings.fix: Matched by name@version; the earlier exam is kept and said.

findings.defect: The tests pinned today's artefacts (2 passed, a point with no homework).
findings.scenario: 29.2 and 29.4 change them by design and would turn the tests red with no defect.
findings.fix: Every expectation is read from the result files, manifests and cards.

measurements.name: the register on this repository (2026-10-17)
measurements.gate: every point a row; every number equal to its file
measurements.result: 52 points: 13 with homework, 13 with a student, 2 passed their exam, none serving above whisper, 10 not decided; checked in the browser on the Admin tab with no console error
measurements.against_gate: Met: the tests compare every manifest, card and verdict with the register's rows.
limits: The workspace used for the check had no shadow labels: the labels still needed show the minimum.

outcome: Every choice DCLab makes is on one page with its student's standing, and the command keeps each run's register as data.
lessons: A register that reads files must use each file's own denominator: the same word (decisions) meant played rows in one manifest and labelled rows in another.
Expectations in a test should come from the artefacts the code reads when the plan says those artefacts will change.
risks: The shadow measurement loads every fitted model once per process (seconds), as the routing page already does.
